verdict.rationale: Forter documents an agentic-orders flow. Merchants set orderType to AI_AGENT and pass agent metadata (e.g., ChatGPT or Gemini) so Forter's risk decision accounts for agent-sourced orders and reports on agentic traffic. That supports agent purchases being evaluated rather than blanket-blocked, but the distinction depends on the merchant declaring the source, not on Forter detecting agents itself. missing for 10: evidence that Forter itself detects or verifies legitimate AI agents versus malicious bots, explicit evidence that agent orders avoid blanket decline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
